hero.headline: I'm Igor, building software with intentionality and craft.
hero.subtitle: Senior Software Engineer specializing in Java, Node.js, React, and TypeScript — nearly 8 years building scalable, user-centric applications.

about.label: 01. About
about.body: I'm a software developer with nearly 8 years of experience across backend and frontend, currently at Cognyte in Florianópolis. I work with Java, Node.js, React, and React Native to build scalable, high-performance applications. Passionate about clean code, modern architectures, and user-centric design, I thrive in collaborative environments and focus on delivering measurable value.

cognyte.title: Senior Software Engineer
cognyte.description: Designed and implemented features for an investigative analytics platform using Java and React. Built scalable data visualization tools, reduced processing times by 25% through refactoring, and delivered dynamic reporting with JasperReports and Bold Report.

konviva.title: Frontend Developer
konviva.description: Developed customized frontend solutions for EdTech platforms from detailed prototypes. Implemented a version control system for customer themes and maintained legacy systems while collaborating with design and backend teams.

animati.title: Fullstack Software Developer
animati.description: Built features for a radiology web platform focused on image visualization and report generation. Assisted in SCRUM team management, handled version control and product releases, and maintained PostgreSQL databases for healthcare clients.

animatiIntern.title: Intern Software Developer
animatiIntern.description: Contributed to the evolution of a radiology platform using Java, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL, and JavaScript. Developed reports, printing models, and new features for medical imaging workflows.
